caseNameFull: Starr, Attorney General v. Schram, Receiver
attorneys: Messrs. Herbert J. Rushton, Attorney General of Michigan, JamesF. Shepherd, Chief Assistant Attorney General, and Merlin Wiley for petitioner. Messrs. Robert S. Marx, Frank E. Wood, and George P. Barse for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writs of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Murphy took no part in the consideration and decision of this application.
